name: The Mountain God Rises (iQPS Launch 10)
agency: Institute for Q-shu Pioneers of Space
location_str: Rocket Lab LC-1A @ Rocket Lab Launch Complex 1, NZL
destination_explanation: Even at this height there are faint wisps of atmosphere. They slowly drag satellites down, so anything here needs an occasional push to stay up.
slot_a_text: Synthetic aperture radar Earth observation satellite for Japanese Earth imaging company iQPS.
slot_b_text: It has already slipped twice. The current time was set 12 days ago and has held since. The window is instantaneous, so it goes on time or not at all.
